_note: Research is done by a craftsman at the Workshop (it goes through the same queue as crafting). cost is paid when a craftsman takes the order, time is seconds at speed 1. needLevel: Workshop level required. unlocks.recipes: recipe ids that become craftable; unlocks.levels: highest level buildings of that kind may be upgraded to. Recipes and levels listed in no tech are open from the start.
